missing_evidence: Postgres server-side connection metrics (active/max connections, wait time) to confirm pool saturation rather than a postgres outage
Order service logs for pool acquisition timeout messages
candidates.statement: Order service postgres save_order fails with DependencyUnavailable while the connection pool shows size=5 and idle=0 across all sampled traces, so checkout requests time out and the gateway returns 502. Order metrics show 13.68/60s of save_order failures and 3.61/60s of readyz 503s on version 1.0.0.
candidates.uncertainty: Pool size/idle attributes are client-reported; no postgres-side saturation metric was admitted to distinguish exhaustion from postgres unavailability.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502s driven by order ReadTimeout, with postgres save_order returning DependencyUnavailable and pool idle=0/size=5 in every sample. Order metrics confirm save_order failures and readyz 503s on v1.0.0. Deployment record only establishes version facts, not causation. Bounded candidate: db-pool-exhaustion.
